packetSetCompletenessBasis: The official JDF 491 guide requires a motion, an order, a notice and a second order, and it names all four: JDF 477 (Motion), JDF 492 (Order), JDF 493 (Notice) and JDF 478 (Order). The verified Master Library holds JDF-477 and JDF-478, and this packet delivers those two. JDF 492 and JDF 493 are NOT delivered. Until 2026-09-10 this manifest declared only the two delivered components, so no committed record said this route owes four documents, and the delivered participant guide stated without qualification that the packet is “two Colorado Judicial Department forms, filed together”. The two undelivered components are not owed the same thing: JDF 492's identity is established from its own printed face and its bytes are held at the digest the committed index records, blocked only because that index entry carries formNumber null and assetClass null; the JDF 493 the recovery pool holds is a 2019-08 flat PDF with zero form fields against a 2024-08-07 guide, so acquisition at the named revision is owed for it. The set is incomplete because two required documents are missing.

guide.title: Guide to Sealing Non-Conviction Records (simplified process)
guide.fileTheRequest: File these forms into your criminal case:  JDF 477 Motion • Be sure to list all agency addresses you found in Step 1.  JDF 492 Order (just do §§ A-C)  JDF 493 Notice (Just do §§ A-C)  JDF 478 Order (just do §§ A-C)
guide.howItWasRead: every quoted phrase asserted as a literal substring of the concatenated text items of the named page, in stream order. Unlike JDF 477 and JDF 478 this document does not interleave its glyph runs; the stream is clean prose and pdftotext agrees with it.

undelivered.sourceStatusBasis: The official JDF 491 guide, “Guide to Sealing Non-Conviction Records (simplified process)”, R: August 7, 2024, names four forms under its printed heading “File the Request — File these forms into your criminal case”, with no branch and no condition between them: “JDF 477 Motion”, “JDF 492 Order (just do §§ A-C)”, “JDF 493 Notice (Just do §§ A-C)” and “JDF 478 Order (just do §§ A-C)”. Its page 2 confirms one process for cases ending in acquittal, a completed diversion agreement, a completed deferred judgment or a vacated conviction, under C.R.S. §§ 24-72-705 and 707 — the same statute and the same dispositions as this route. The guide is held at sha256 79dca4e720161b68ae74a8973392bbe22c05f565f704c609ec7cc7da0fcd3685 in the mounted Master Library at STATES/CO/03_INSTRUCTIONS/CO__INSTRUCTIONS__JDF-491__guide-to-sealing-non-conviction-records__REV-2024-08-07__EN.pdf. The notice is JDF 493. TWO THINGS ABOUT THE HELD BINARY TRAVEL WITH THIS COMPONENT. FIRST, the committed index carries “LegalEase Colorado/reference-only/JDF-493__order-and-notice-of-hearing-to-seal-non-conviction-records__rev-2019-08.pdf”, sha256 fb500eb1d0f04e7ab5a7bd1f4932cff27edb451a5c2d66c60288fad96726ef1c, 51,649 bytes, 1 page, in custody nationwide_recovery_pool_2026_09_02, with formNumber null, assetClass null, acroFormPresent false, acroFieldCount 0 and structuralClassObserved flat_pdf. Lane FIX157, 2026-09-10 found that custody mounted and re-hashed the file: the bytes on disk carry that exact digest. SECOND, the held revision is 2019-08 and the guide that names it is R: August 7, 2024. The guide says to complete “§§ A-C” and the held 2019 document has no lettered sections at all — its caption band is unlettered and it prints a CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE that the 2024-revision orders in this family do not. So this component is not blocked in the same way as its sibling: the held binary carries zero form fields and cannot be filled by the official_pdf_fill strategy this component declares, and there is affirmative evidence on its own face that it is not the revision the 2024 guide names. What is owed here is acquisition of JDF 493 at the revision JDF 491 R: August 7, 2024 names, not a classification of the held bytes.
